detail.longDescription: Do you copy posts from your Facebook Page and paste them into LinkedIn? What if you didn't have to do the copying and pasting yourself? Set up a Zap once, and every new post on your Facebook Page gets published to LinkedIn on its own, with no more copy and paste. In this article, I'll show you how to publish such posts on your personal LinkedIn page and a company LinkedIn page. Each starts from a ready-made Zap template you can have running in a few minutes. Automatically publish Facebook Pages
